body: {"better": "B", "reason": "Card A says '1 స్టాప్‌లో దిగి' which is ambiguous (could mean 'get off in 1 stop' or 'get off at the stop'), then redundantly repeats 'దిగండి' without clarifying the 12-minute walk. Card B clearly states '1 స్టాపుల తర్వాత' then '12 నిమిషాల నడక' — accurately including the 12-minute walk that Card A omitted. Card B also gives the reason (beautiful Hindu temple) while Card A only says 'దేవుడి దర్శనం' without connecting it to the venue
